blocks.text: WASHINGTON D.C., United States—US President Donald Trump said Thursday he was too busy during his Asia tour to meet with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un as he had suggested, NBC News reported. He added that they will confer at some point. “The relationship is there, but we didn’t meet,” Trump said, according to NBC News reporter Gabe Gutierrez, who said he spoke with Trump as they were flying back to Washington from Asia.
